about: Sudden Termination (docs/adr/0064-sleep-restart-shut-down-and-log-out.mdx, decision 10), as a Mac logs out: an application with nothing unsaved, no quit handler and no storage write pending is ended at once, never asked, and only the one with unsaved work is asked. Crash Probe (sample/CrashProbe.tsx, installed, its storage written as it starts: "Ready, launch 1") and Allo (sample/QuitProbe.tsx, which handles the question and has unsaved changes), over logind played on the run's own bus. Alt+Shift+Super+Q (log out at once): Crash Probe is ended at once, asked nothing; Allo is asked, once, and cancels, the session naming only it. Saved, Alt+Shift+Super+Q again: Allo agrees and the session ends. With the session asking every application, Crash Probe is asked and the run fails.

steps.name: Crash Probe from the dock: its storage written, nothing unsaved
Alt+Shift+Super+Q: Crash Probe ended at once and asked nothing; Allo asked once, and it cancels; the session names only Allo
Alt+Shift+Super+Q again: Allo agrees and quits, and the session ends
